summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of Anushka Kandhway portfolio site. All 10 pytest backend tests pass (root, projects list/by-slug/404, contact POST valid/invalid/missing, contact list newest-first). Frontend smoke + integration test confirms hero, featured work (3 cards), stats, contact section, footer, custom cursor, contact modal open/close/submit flow, validation on empty submit, and case-study navigation all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: timestamp stored in Mongo as ISO string then re-parsed on GET — works but inconsistent; consider storing as native datetime so MongoDB sort uses BSON date.
server.py: no pagination on GET /api/contact (hardcoded to_list(500)); fine for MVP, document a limit if growth expected.
PROJECTS list is in-memory and re-created on every restart — acceptable for MVP, add DB if persistence needed.
